characters.name: Richard Wagner
characters.description: Narrator; composer and author of this autobiography, recounting his childhood, musical development, and early career

characters.name: Friedrich Wagner
characters.description: Richard Wagner’s father; a clerk in the police service at Leipzig who died in 1813

characters.name: Ludwig Geyer
characters.description: Actor, painter and Wagner’s stepfather who married his mother and introduced theatrical/artistic influences into the family

characters.name: Adolph Wagner
characters.description: Richard Wagner’s uncle and philologist; influential in Wagner’s education and literary development

characters.name: Jeannette Thome
characters.description: Friend of Adolph Wagner and occupant of rooms used by Adolph and his sister in Leipzig; hosted Wagner as a child

characters.name: Friederike Wagner
characters.description: Sister of Adolph Wagner who kept house with him

characters.name: Wetzel
characters.description: Vicar and early schoolmaster at Possendorf near Dresden who gave Wagner country schooling and told stories such as Robinson Crusoe

characters.name: Rosalie
characters.description: Wagner’s elder sister and a professional actress who supported the family after their stepfather’s death

characters.name: Clara (sister, book)
characters.description: Wagner’s sister with significant early singing talent; made a debut in Italian opera as ‘Cenerentola’

characters.name: Louisa (book)
characters.description: Wagner’s sister who pursued an acting career (engagements in Breslau and Leipzig)

characters.name: Albert (book)
characters.description: Wagner’s elder brother, originally intended for medicine, later had theatrical connections

characters.name: Julius (brother, book)
characters.description: Wagner’s brother apprenticed to his uncle the goldsmith in Eisleben

characters.name: Ottilie (book)
characters.description: Wagner’s sister who befriended notable families in Prague and was a confidante to young Wagner

characters.name: Professor Sillig
characters.description: Young teacher at the Kreuz Grammar School who encouraged Wagner’s metric translations and poetry

characters.name: Baumgarten-Crusius
characters.description: Assistant headmaster at the Kreuz/Nicolai school in Leipzig who punished Wagner and with whom Wagner had conflicts

characters.name: Starke
characters.description: Schoolfellow who suddenly fell dead while Wagner was at school; this event prompted school poems

characters.name: Humann
characters.description: Music tutor engaged for Wagner around age twelve who gave him early piano lessons

characters.name: Mieksch
characters.description: Clara Wagner’s singing master who developed her voice

characters.name: Carl Maria von Weber (book)
characters.description: Conductor and composer; influential early musical figure in Wagner’s life (conductor at Dresden)

characters.name: Sassaroli
characters.description: Italian male-soprano vocalist remembered by Wagner for his effeminate style and influence on Wagner’s early distaste for Italian singing

characters.name: G. Müller
characters.description: Music teacher (later organist at Altenburg) who gave Wagner harmony lessons covertly

characters.name: Flachs
characters.description: Eccentric local musical figure in Leipzig whom Wagner mistook for an original/conductor figure (inspired by Hoffmannian archetypes)

characters.name: Kuhnlein
characters.description: Musical conductor in Magdeburg described as eccentric, admirer of Mozart and critic of Weber; influenced Wagner’s views

characters.name: Theodor Apel
characters.description: Friend and poet (son of August Apel) who influenced Wagner in Prague; Wagner set one of his poems to music

characters.name: W. Marsano
characters.description: Handsome acquaintance in Prague’s salon circle, mentioned among youthful acquaintances

characters.name: Count Pachta (book)
characters.description: Aristocratic patron in Prague who befriended Wagner’s sister Ottilie and whose daughters entertained Wagner in his youth

characters.name: Jenny (Pachta, book)
characters.description: One of Count Pachta’s daughters, described as a beauty and friend of Wagner’s sister Ottilie

characters.name: Auguste (Pachta, book)
characters.description: One of Count Pachta’s daughters, friend of Ottilie; described as beautiful and attached to the family circle

characters.name: St. Georges
characters.description: Playwright/composer referenced in Paris dealings (mentioned later re: librettos)

characters.name: Moritz (actor)
characters.description: Actor in Prague recommended to Wagner’s family; hosted Wagner and influenced his Prague acquaintances

characters.name: Heinrich Dorn
characters.description: Musical director and later a permanent municipal appointment; taught and worked with Wagner in Leipzig and Riga

characters.name: Weinlich
characters.description: Theodor Weinlich, choirmaster and musical director at St. Thomas’s Church who taught Wagner counterpoint and fugue

characters.name: M. Schott (publisher)
characters.description: Music publisher (Schott of Mainz) who corresponded with Wagner about copying the Ninth Symphony and other works

characters.name: Friedrich Schmitt
characters.description: Young tenor acquaintance (later singer) who befriended Wagner in Magdeburg and supported him

characters.name: Gebhardt
characters.description: A strikingly handsome and strong undergraduate friend among student companions in Leipzig

characters.name: Degelow
characters.description: Reckless student friend in Leipzig, noted duellist and adventurer; died from wounds in a duel at Jena

characters.name: Stelzer (Lope)
characters.description: Student known as ‘Lope’, a wild daredevil of the university clubs in Leipzig

characters.name: Schroter
characters.description: Older companion in the Leipzig undergraduates; introduced Wagner to Heine and witty societies

characters.name: Levy (Lippert)
characters.description: Student acquaintance (Jew named Levy, also known as Lippert) referenced in duel anecdotes

characters.name: Tischer
characters.description: Opponent chosen for Wagner’s first planned duel in Leipzig who ended up in hospital preventing the fight

characters.name: Wohlfart
characters.description: Old stager swordsman in Leipzig who was severely wounded in a duel witnessed by Wagner

characters.name: Count Solms
characters.description: Member of Wagner’s student club who advised caution regarding duels and student life

characters.name: Friederike Galvani
characters.description: Young singer and early love interest of Wagner at Wurzburg; later became a mother

characters.name: Friedrich Brockhaus (book)
characters.description: Bookseller and member of the Brockhaus family mentioned in connection with Wagner’s early career

characters.name: Hermann Brockhaus (book)
characters.description: Younger brother of Friedrich Brockhaus; Orientalist and later professor; husband of Wagner’s sister Ottilie

characters.name: General Bem
characters.description: Polish general and exile in Leipzig who impressed Wagner during the Polish events of 1831

characters.name: Count Vincenz Tyszkiewitcz
characters.description: Polish noble and exile in Leipzig; friend and patron figure to whom Wagner was attached

characters.name: Janusz
characters.description: Son of Count Vincenz Tyszkiewitcz (referred to by name in narrative)

characters.name: Bansemer
characters.description: Cavalry captain among the Polish exiles in Leipzig who befriended Wagner’s circle

characters.name: Laube (book)
characters.description: Heinrich Laube, friend and poet who influenced Wagner and with whom he corresponded

characters.name: Heine (book)
characters.description: Heinrich Heine, poet whose works Laube and others discussed and who influenced Wagner’s literary tastes

characters.name: Wilhelmine Schroder-Devrient (book)
characters.description: Renowned actress and singer whose performance in Fidelio deeply inspired Wagner and influenced his artistic aims

characters.name: Kietz (book)
characters.description: Ernst Kietz, painter (portraitist) who befriended Wagner in early years, sketched him and supported him materially at times

characters.name: Kittl (book)
characters.description: Young musician Wagner met in Prague who later became a composer/conductor

characters.name: Rochlitz
characters.description: Friedrich Rochlitz, impresario of Gewandhaus concerts in Leipzig who agreed to present Wagner’s symphony

characters.name: Pohlenz
characters.description: Orchestra leader/conductor in Leipzig (Gewandhaus) who conducted Beethoven’s Ninth there and influenced Wagner’s views on performance

characters.name: Zillmann
characters.description: Leader of a town band in Dresden whose open-air concerts fascinated young Wagner

characters.name: Mlle. Palazzesi
characters.description: Singer who performed at a recital where Wagner introduced one of his orchestral works

characters.name: Mme. Pauline Viardot
characters.description: Prominent singer in Paris who heard Wagner’s songs and gave him feedback (mentioned in Paris episodes)

characters.name: Habeneck
characters.description: Étienne-Nicolas Habeneck, conductor at the Paris Conservatoire who promised to rehearse Wagner’s work

characters.name: Meyerbeer
characters.description: Giacomo Meyerbeer, leading composer in Paris who aided Wagner with introductions and advice

characters.name: Duponchel
characters.description: Manager of the Paris Opera who met Wagner with polite interest

characters.name: Gouin
characters.description: M. Gouin, Meyerbeer’s agent in Paris who negotiated on Wagner’s behalf and worked with local managers

characters.name: Leon Pillet
characters.description: Director of the Théâtre de la Renaissance in Paris who considered Wagner’s theatrical ideas and purchased a plot

characters.name: Dumersan
characters.description: M. Dumersan, translator/author in Paris who translated Wagner’s Liebesverbot into French verse

characters.name: Schlesinger
characters.description: Maurice/Moritz Schlesinger (music publisher/editor of the Gazette Musicale) who commissioned journalistic and arrangement work from Wagner in Paris

characters.name: Berlioz (book)
characters.description: Hector Berlioz, French composer whose orchestral works and symphonies impressed Wagner in Paris

characters.name: Mme. Dorus-Gras
characters.description: Daughter/celebrated soprano of the Paris stage (sang for Wagner’s trial audience)

characters.name: Lablache
characters.description: Famous bass in Paris whom Wagner approached about inserting an aria into Norma

characters.name: Halevy
characters.description: Fromental Halevy, composer of La Reine de Chypre and La Juive; Wagner reviewed and arranged some of his work in Paris

characters.name: Villemain
characters.description: M. Villemain, French Minister of Education who intervened to aid a needy scholar (Lehrs)

characters.name: Anders
characters.description: E. G. Anders, German-born music bibliographer in Paris who befriended Wagner and assisted with bibliographic and cultural contacts

characters.name: Lehrs
characters.description: Philologist and friend/housemate of Anders in Paris; a close intellectual friend of Wagner who supported and conversed with him

characters.name: Brix
characters.description: German commercial traveller and amateur flautist who lodged with Wagner in Paris and later helped in small ways

characters.name: Count Kuscelew
characters.description: Count Kuscelew, patron who offered Wagner a sum (and later was not further engaged) while Wagner was in Paris

characters.name: M. Jadin
characters.description: Eccentric older Paris resident near Meudon encountered by Wagner; a flamboyant amateur who made a memorable impression

characters.name: Edouard Monnaie
characters.description: Commissaire for the Royal Theatres in Paris and editor associated with musical administration; intermediary in Wagner’s Paris dealings

characters.name: Paul Faucher
characters.description: Literary figure associated with Victor Hugo’s circle, mentioned in connexion with theatrical plotting

characters.name: Richard Wagner (My Life — Volume 1)
characters.description: Narrator and composer; author of the memoir recounting events in Dresden, Leipzig, Berlin, Paris, Zürich and travels

characters.name: Minna
characters.description: Wagner’s wife; accompanies and cares for him during parts of his Dresden, Zürich and Paris period

characters.name: Clara (My Life — Volume 1)
characters.description: Wagner’s sister who shares his feelings and supports him in Dresden

characters.name: Wife of the invalid Italian singer
characters.description: Wife of the Italian singer who ill-treats her husband and later provokes his enmity toward Wagner

characters.name: Risse
characters.description: A stiff Philistine, a minor bass singer at the Dresden theatre who greets Wagner on the morning of Rienzi’s first performance

characters.name: Fischer
characters.description: Worthwhile chorus-master at the Dresden theatre and a steadfast collaborator and friend in rehearsals

characters.name: Tichatschek
characters.description: Leading tenor at the Dresden theatre whose singing contributes significantly to Rienzi’s success but whose style Wagner finds limiting for other roles

characters.name: Wachter
characters.description: Baritone singer at Dresden (once noted as a ‘Barber of Seville’) cast in various roles including the Mariner in Fliegender Holländer

characters.name: Schroder-Devrient (My Life)
characters.description: Prima donna singer (Sophie Schröder-Devrient) who works closely with Wagner on parts (notably Senta); powerful actress and central collaborator

characters.name: Sophie Schroder
characters.description: Sophie Schröder, mother of Schroder-Devrient, influential in her daughter’s decisions

characters.name: Johanna (my niece)
characters.description: Wagner’s niece, a young singer who impersonates roles such as Iphigenia and later Adriano; receives training and rises in reputation

characters.name: Friedrich Brockhaus (My Life)
characters.description: Publisher and friend who visits from Leipzig; member of the Brockhaus family appearing in Wagner’s circle

characters.name: Fritz Brockhaus
characters.description: Brother-in-law of Wagner (mentioned hosting Mendelssohn and Devrient)

characters.name: Heinrich Brockhaus (My Life)
characters.description: Publisher who later takes possession of Wagner’s library as security for a debt

characters.name: Julius (brother, My Life)
characters.description: Wagner’s brother Julius who attends performances and comments from an audience box

characters.name: Lüttichau
characters.description: General director of the Dresden Royal Theatre; central theatre official who negotiates with Wagner and the court

characters.name: Julius Mosen
characters.description: Poet and acquaintance of Wagner in Dresden who criticises Wagner after Rienzi’s success

characters.name: Karl (Herr Karl) Bank
characters.description: Musical critic in Dresden who becomes hostile to Wagner

characters.name: Julius Schladebach
characters.description: Another Dresden critic who figures among Wagner’s press opponents

characters.name: Rastrelli
characters.description: Royal director of music whose sudden death creates a vacancy leading to Wagner’s appointment

characters.name: Morlacchi
characters.description: Mentioned musician whose death previously left a conductorship vacant

characters.name: Reissiger
characters.description: Colleague conductor at Dresden who conducts repertoire and whose relations with Wagner become strained

characters.name: Karl Lipinsky
characters.description: Celebrated violinist and long-time leader of the Dresden orchestra, proud and temperamental

characters.name: August Röckel
characters.description: Young musician, nephew of Hummel; becomes Wagner’s intimate friend, assistant, and political companion

characters.name: Anton Pusinelli
characters.description: Young physician near Wagner who becomes a devoted friend and family doctor

characters.name: Marie von Konneritz
characters.description: Frau von Konneritz (née Fink), wife of Chamberlain von Konneritz, social contact of Wagner in Dresden

characters.name: Countess Rossi (Henriette Sontag)
characters.description: The celebrated singer Henriette Sontag (referred to as Countess Rossi) who greets Wagner warmly

characters.name: Professor Lowe
characters.description: Organizer and energetic president of the Dresden Glee Club who initiates musical festivals and patriotic projects

characters.name: Ferdinand Hiller
characters.description: Composer and conductor active in Dresden musical circles, organiser of subscription concerts and a social host

characters.name: Felix Mendelssohn
characters.description: Composer and conductor encountered by Wagner in Leipzig and Dresden; influential musical figure

characters.name: Robert Schumann
characters.description: Composer and critic who appears in Dresden salon life and discusses musical matters with Wagner

characters.name: Franz Liszt
characters.description: Pianist, conductor and influential friend who befriends Wagner, attends performances, and later champions his works

characters.name: Belloni
characters.description: Liszt’s secretary who arranges introductions and concert tickets for Wagner in Paris and elsewhere

characters.name: Mendelssohn’s friend Devrient (reference)
characters.description: Refers to members of the Devrient theatrical family mentioned collectively in Wagner’s circle

characters.name: Eduard Devrient
characters.description: Actor, director and Gluck connoisseur who collaborates with Wagner on stage matters and Gluck productions

characters.name: Emil Devrient
characters.description: Actor of the Devrient family; mentioned in connection with theatrical affairs

characters.name: Jenny Pachta (My Life)
characters.description: Friend from Wagner’s youth, mentioned as having been married into the aristocracy

characters.name: Auguste Pachta (My Life)
characters.description: Friend from Wagner’s youth, mentioned alongside Jenny as married into the aristocracy

characters.name: Karl (or Herr) Küstner
characters.description: Manager of the Berlin theatre who arranges productions and communications with Wagner

characters.name: Henning (or Henniger)
characters.description: Conductor at the Berlin theatre whose limitations forced Wagner to conduct rehearsals

characters.name: Conductor Taubert
characters.description: Conductor in Berlin mentioned as reporting on Wagner and later conducting performances

characters.name: Spontini
characters.description: The aged master composer who visits Dresden to supervise productions (Gaspare Spontini); eccentric, demanding, influential

characters.name: Berlioz (My Life)
characters.description: Hector Berlioz, composer; appears in relation to Spontini’s later death and anecdote

characters.name: Marschner
characters.description: Heinrich Marschner, composer mentioned in connection with Dresden productions and his own operas

characters.name: Hänel
characters.description: Sculptor present in Dresden artistic circles, contributor to salon life

characters.name: Rietschel
characters.description: Sculptor and artist in Dresden artistic society referenced among salon meetings

characters.name: Gutzkow
characters.description: Playwright employed by the theatre to produce spoken drama; his management appointment is discussed

characters.name: Laube (My Life)
characters.description: Friend and editor who earlier supported Wagner and later resumed an editorial role and commentary

characters.name: Gottfried Semper
characters.description: Architect and public personality who participates in artistic and political salon debates in Dresden

characters.name: F. Hiller (wife)
characters.description: Frau Hiller (wife of Ferdinand Hiller), noted as a Polish-born singer and hostess in Dresden society

characters.name: Peps
characters.description: Wagner’s little dog, born on the day of the first Rienzi rehearsal; constant companion in Dresden and later

characters.name: Papo (parrot)
characters.description: Parrot acquired by Wagner as a gift from a manager during a trip to Hamburg; later kept by Minna and taught to sing selections from Rienzi

characters.name: Count Redern
characters.description: Court musical director in Berlin who advises Wagner on royal permissions and dedications

characters.name: M. Illaire
characters.description: Head of the Royal Privy Council in Berlin whom Wagner approaches about reading Lohengrin to the King

characters.name: Louis Spohr
characters.description: Composer whom Wagner visits in Leipzig and whose late opera and opinions are discussed

characters.name: F. Kittl (My Life)
characters.description: Friend and acquaintance of Wagner encountered on trips (Kittl) who appears in Prague and elsewhere

characters.name: G. Herwegh
characters.description: Georg Herwegh (poet/activist) referenced in connection with Bakunin and revolutionary acquaintances

characters.name: Michael Bakunin
characters.description: Revolutionary (Mikhail/Michael Bakunin) who joins Dresden events, offers radical counsel and participates in barricade activity

characters.name: August (or Adolf) Stahr
characters.description: Critic (Adolf Stahr) who raises objections about Lohengrin’s dramatic solution in correspondence with Wagner

characters.name: Werder
characters.description: Professor Werder, an early admirer who visits Wagner after a Berlin performance and commends the work highly

characters.name: Alwine Frommann
characters.description: A woman of independent means and ardent admirer who writes Wagner an effusive letter after hearing works in Berlin and supports him

characters.name: Kietz (My Life)
characters.description: Artist and early friend who engraved Wagner’s portrait and later worked for him; also custodian of some title-pages and designs

characters.name: Carl Maria von Weber (My Life)
characters.description: Composer whose remains Wagner helps transfer to Dresden; subject of a commemorative enterprise

characters.name: Caroline von Weber
characters.description: Weber’s widow who urges Wagner to accept the Dresden conductorship and later aids him in memorialising Weber

characters.name: Gottfried Kockel
characters.description: Supporter and sympathiser present in rehearsals who helps Wagner with orchestral matters

characters.name: H. Truhn
characters.description: Musician/commentator in Dresden who attends salon meetings and offers views on dramatic music and performance

characters.name: Herr von Munchhausen
characters.description: The tall slim young man with whom Schroder-Devrient forms a new liaison

characters.name: Muller (ex-Minister of Education)
characters.description: Muller, the ex-Minister of Education and father of a young lieutenant of the Guards mentioned in Devrient’s affairs

aliases.text: the son of Muller, the ex-Minister of Education

characters.name: Muller (contrabassist from Darmstadt)
characters.description: A contrabassist named Muller from Darmstadt whom Lipinsky recommends for a post in the Dresden orchestra

characters.name: Professor Kochly
characters.description: Philologist who attends concerts and is impressed by Wagner’s performances

characters.name: Professor Droysen
characters.description: Historian cited as influence on Wagner’s study of Greek tragedy (appears as referenced authority in Wagner’s reflections)

characters.name: Professor Franck
characters.description: Hermann and Albert Franck: two Francks who participated in intellectual support and editorial contacts for Wagner

characters.name: Alexander von Weber
characters.description: Son of Carl Maria von Weber, mentioned in connection with the transfer of his father’s remains

characters.name: Frau Julie Ritter
characters.description: Madame Julie Ritter, benevolent supporter who aided Wagner and whose family befriended him

characters.name: Karl Ritter
characters.description: Young man from the Ritter family who visited Wagner and befriended him; acted as intermediary and companion

characters.name: Mme. Jessie Laussot
characters.description: Madame Jessie Laussot, an Englishwoman married in Bordeaux who befriended Wagner and invited him to Bordeaux; later became entangled in family conflict

characters.name: Eugene Laussot (M. Laussot)
characters.description: Eugène Laussot, Jessie Laussot’s husband, a Bordeaux wine-merchant involved in domestic conflict over Jessie’s friendship with Wagner

characters.name: Mrs. Taylor
characters.description: Madame Taylor, Jessie Laussot’s English mother, influential in the Laussot household and active in the family’s disputes

characters.name: Nathalie
characters.description: ‘So-called sister’ of Jessie Laussot who accompanies her in travel; a participant in domestic episodes

characters.name: Professor Siebert
characters.description: Weimar professor and contact of Liszt who helps Wagner with introductions and arrangements in Weimar

characters.name: Professor Widmann
characters.description: Professor who offers Wagner the use of his passport and assistance during flight from Germany

characters.name: Heubner
characters.description: Kreis-Amtmann Heubner, civic official who seized and held a barricade during the Dresden rising and later became a leader of the provisional government

characters.name: Todt
characters.description: Member of the Dresden provisional government who appears in the Town Hall during the rising

characters.name: Tschirner
characters.description: Member of the Dresden provisional government who participates in council activities

characters.name: Stephan Born
characters.description: Compositor and revolutionary who takes command roles among volunteers and helps organise insurgent bands

characters.name: Marschall von Bieberstein
characters.description: A lawyer and senior officer who takes part in provisional government efforts and escorts volunteers

characters.name: Leo von Zichlinsky
characters.description: Officer entrusted with covering a retreat and aiding provisional operations

characters.name: Haimberger
characters.description: A young Galician/Polish violinist associated with Bakunin, present among the Town Hall defendants and volunteers

characters.name: Martin (post-office clerk)
characters.description: Energetic post-office clerk active in the provisional government’s operations
